The answer covers the first two facts: Ask is a panel in the app, and people ask questions about the records. It doesn't say Ask reads only what the person is allowed to read. "Only answers without changing anything" means Ask is read-only, which is a different point. "According to the app's access rules" refers to who can use Ask, not to which records it can read for them.

The answer says the docs give no hosting price for the app, which loosely overlaps with pricing not being set. But it never says the beta is free; it only says the software is free and open source under Apache-2.0 and that operations cost nothing. That is not the same as a free beta, and it never states that pricing and plans are not yet set. It also adds unrelated details such as the €0.002 model call figure. It does avoid stating a monthly price or a per-app price, so no mustNot is violated. Because it misses the required fact that the beta is free, it fails.
